method: parliament_ai_study.review --verify (deterministic seed 2026 sample, containment of normalized speech_text in the record's own official source)

statuses.verified: record text found verbatim after whitespace/case folding
statuses.normalized: found after ignoring punctuation spacing, decorative characters, and apostrophe style
statuses.partial: every substantial segment found; inline material removed by cleaning (audience cues, page markers) accounts for the difference
statuses.mismatch: record text not located in the source; requires manual investigation
statuses.skipped: source not retrievable by this tool

limitation: 10 records per country is a screening sample, not a completed manual audit. A human must still read sampled records against the official page.
